latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — Free Long Video Maker lets you create and export long, watermark-free videos in 1080p MP4.

- Upload long video footage (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) and generate full-length videos with no watermark.
- Automatic backend connection and session setup, with 100 free credits per user (no paid subscription needed for watermark-free exports).
- Supports intuitive workflows: quick edit, batch, and iterative video creation.
- Exports processed via secure cloud GPU pipeline, with export/download links provided when complete.
- Responds to natural-language instructions and key commands like "upload", "export", "balance".
- Automatic error handling and workflow guidance for file size/type, login/token, credits, and rate limits.
